Thanks Rachel — reviewing now. FYI for the thread: primary legal points we typically flag for enterprise buyers are: 

1) Payment terms & late fees: we prefer net 45 for new enterprise contracts (can be negotiated to net 30 with volume).
2) Data processing / residency: we will accept customer data residency requests but need a DPA addendum for large regulated customers (healthcare requires specific DPA language).
3) IP & license carve-outs: ensure limited license to use outputs, no assignment of model IP.
4) PO acceptance mechanics: clarify that POs referencing our order form are accepted when acknowledged (we avoid blanket "silence = acceptance").
5) Indemnity & cap: standard mutual indemnities; cap tied to annual fees.

Ive attached a redlined MSA and a redlined order form with inline comments for the procurement team. The key asks for Nexa: produce a sample PO XML (line-item level) and confirm whether they require EDI/AS2 or if Coupa SFTP/API is sufficient. Also confirm vendor remit and tax IDs so we can populate the order form.

Attachments: Redlined_MSA_NexaHealth_v1.pdf; Redlined_OrderForm_NexaHealth_v1.xlsx

I can join the call — Tue 13th 10:00am PST works for me. Jonas, can you take point on sample PO validation?
